tools.name: argus_verify_agent
tools.description: Verify ownership of an agent endpoint: checks that the verify token is served at https://<endpoint>/.well-known/argus-verify.txt. Run this before registering the agent in Argus Console.

tools.name: argus_list_agents
tools.description: List the user's registered agents (name, role, endpoint) and their free tier. MOCK simulation is FREE: no payment, nothing to deploy, rolling cap 25 runs / 24h (paid quota untouched). The response includes freeSimulation { used, limit, resetsAt }.

tools.name: argus_run_simulation
tools.description: Run a free MOCK battery against a registered agent: the full pipeline (money guard gate + fault probes) in deterministic simulation seeded by the endpoint. Does not touch paid quota; rolling cap 25 runs / 24h. Waits for completion and returns the report.

tools.name: argus_run_engine
tools.description: Run the REAL Argus engine battery (canonical S8 + fault scenarios) against a live agent using paid quota. CLIENT agents only. May take minutes — returns the run id to poll via argus_get_run_report.

tools.name: argus_get_run_report
tools.description: Fetch the report of a finished run: money guard outcome, verdict counts, per-probe verdicts, proven/violations/not-established lists.
